scope_and_limits: This is a four-dependent-case replication and retention upgrade of already-observed decoder endpoints, not a new image prediction from unseen input or a new semantic task.

The functional graph reuses the frozen explicit helper and original Torch primitive kernels. It does not independently reproduce CUDA convolution, group normalization, attention, or reduction arithmetic.
Both lanes share explicit CPU inverse-BN code. Native unpack/unpatch and native decoder comparisons plus saved-only input reconstruction do not amount to an independent full-pipeline BN target.

All named macro arrays are retained; all primitive outputs have full hashes and fixed witnesses. Full primitive arrays are not generally retained. A first mismatch may be reconstructed only after all targets and only attributed to the original forecast if its presealed content hash, shape and dtype match.
Metadata/source/guard chronology is trusted instrument evidence, not cryptographic proof that arbitrary hostile code could not make hidden calls.
